verdict.rationale: Neon ships an official MCP Server (docs + live runtime probe confirming the hosted endpoint) and CLI that let agents run SQL/schema operations against Neon Postgres, and the MCP server docs likely expose scoped tools (e.g., run_sql, list_projects, migrations) though the evidence pack doesn't detail a read-only vs destructive tool permission split. missing for 10: explicit documentation of separate read-only vs destructive tool scopes/permissions within the MCP server, independent hands-on confirmation of safe-delegation behavior, and evidence of confirmation/guardrails for destructive actions.
